## Summary

Explain the user-facing or architectural change.

## Scope

- [ ] Shared package or API service
- [ ] One game only
- [ ] Documentation or tooling only

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant `npm run verify:*` command(s)
- [ ] Cocos Creator preview/build, if `apps/ski-endless/client` changed

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, AppIDs, production domains, or player data were added.
- [ ] Shared code does not contain game-specific rules or presentation.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior or setup changed.
